scope: Current application source mounted read-only into a one-off development test process; existing PostgreSQL/network reused
command: python -m unittest discover -s /source/tests -v in existing development image
data_policy: Most SQL uses a connection-local TEMP tickets table. One named fictional ticket is committed and retained to prove persistence across distinct connections. No existing ticket is removed or changed.
limits: No service redeployed or image rebuilt
No restart, backup, restore, Terraform, Ansible, Kubernetes, CI or physical reception
No user authentication: local fictional-data demonstrator only
